title: Digital glitch artifacts in Shotcut
note: The Shotcut Glitch video filter makes digital distortion with displaced horizontal image bands and color-channel artifacts. Its Frequency controls how often events occur; Block Height sets band size; Shift Intensity controls horizontal offsets and channel separation. Use short bursts when an edit requires impact.

title: Camera shake with Shotcut Shake video filter
note: Shotcut's Shake filter simulates camera movement for action or impact. Its settings include horizontal/vertical amplitude, rotation, speed and blur; stronger amplitudes may expose blank frame edges, so adjust zoom when necessary. Use brief keyframed bursts for Minecraft hits rather than nonstop shaking.

title: How Shotcut keyframes animate changing filter values
note: Shotcut keyframes mark times where an animated filter parameter changes. The editor interpolates appropriate values between keyframes, allowing moves such as zooming or fading a visual/audio parameter. Consult the current filter panel because older forum examples can show controls that later releases changed.

title: Shotcut panel and export shortcuts
note: The official Shotcut keyboard reference lists Ctrl+6 for the Filters panel, Ctrl+7 for Keyframes and Ctrl+E for Export Video on Windows/Linux. Shortcut modifiers differ on macOS, and users can customize key bindings.
